entries.basis: Two independent firsthand Delta MD-90 reports: Aaron Giddings MD-90 economy leg, March3 2017; James seat4A MD90 first class, January22 2020. Extracts are from MD90 sections, not their CRJ900/757/737 legs. Original typo quite retained. Together with Julian Waller/AeroXplorer there are three firsthand publishers. Operator-specific cabins and periods, not prototype or universal seating; technical axes unchanged.
